### 2️⃣ PROMPT DE STORYBOARD (para NotebookLM / Gemini Notebook)

```text
A single 9:16 vertical storyboard sheet containing 9 numbered panels arranged in 1 column x 9 rows.

STYLE
Vox-style editorial paper collage documentary animation. Hand-cut paper cutouts with visible torn and scissor-cut edges, layered over a warm cream textured paper background with visible newsprint fibre, subtle halftone dot pattern and light scanned-print grain. Archival photographic cutouts rendered in grayscale or two-tone duotone, printed on paper with a slight registration offset, some held down with short strips of masking tape. Soft realistic drop shadows under every cut layer so the paper thickness reads clearly.

Restrained editorial palette: warm cream and off-white base, deep ink navy, charcoal black, muted brick red, and ONE saturated accent — highlighter yellow — used sparingly and only for emphasis.

Hand-drawn annotation marks in felt-tip pen: circles, arrows, underlines, dotted guide lines, quick highlighter sweeps.

Deliberately handmade and slightly imperfect — edges not perfectly aligned, textures not perfectly clean. Editorial, not advertising. Never glossy, never 3D-rendered, never flat vector illustration. Clean composition, generous negative space.

TYPOGRAPHY
On-screen typography, Vox editorial house style: heavy condensed sans-serif, all caps, tight letter-spacing, thick uniform strokes. The text sits directly on the paper collage as if letterpress-printed or cut from a newspaper headline — slight ink texture, faint registration offset, no glow, no bevel, no drop shadow of its own.

Colour: ink navy or charcoal printed on the cream paper, or knocked out in cream over a solid navy or brick-red paper block. A single highlighter-yellow marker sweep may underline one word.

The text snaps on in one stop-motion step, as a whole line, on the beat. It never fades in, never types out letter by letter, never scales. Once on screen it does not move or change.

Maximum four words on screen at any time. Exactly one text element per shot. Spelling must be exact — render the given words character for character and add no other text, no captions, no subtitles, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks anywhere in the frame.

PANEL SPECIFICATIONS

Each panel features a small index mark in the upper left corner: a small blue ink circle on cream paper containing the panel number (1 to 9), clearly legible and outside the main composition.

Panel 1:
On-screen text: "PODER MEDICO SIN CONTROL"
Visual: Monochrome archival photo cutout of an vintage operating room placed over textured cream paper with red ink annotations.

Panel 2:
On-screen text: "EXPEDIENTE DE NUREMBERG"

Panel 3:

Panel 4:
On-screen text: "CONSENTIMIENTO INFORMADO OBLIGATORIO"
Visual: Paper cutout of an official medical document with a signature highlighted by a bright yellow marker sweep.

Panel 5:
On-screen text: "COMITES DE EVALUACION"
Visual: Felt-tip arrow diagram on cream paper connecting cutout icons of a hospital building and an ethics approval stamp.

Panel 6:
On-screen text: "ALGORITMOS EN URGENCIAS"
Visual: Hand-drawn bar chart on paper comparing human doctor decisions against a computer algorithm, highlighted in yellow.

Panel 7:
On-screen text: "RESPONSABILIDAD DEL CODIGO"

Panel 8:

Panel 9:
```

**Instrucciones de producción:**
1. **Coste estimado:** 9 × ~15 créditos = ~135 créditos. La cuenta gratuita de Google ofrece 50 créditos al día. Deberás dividir la generación en 3 tandas de 3 escenas por día (SCENE_01-03 el primer día, SCENE_04-06 el segundo y SCENE_07-09 el tercero), pegando **exactamente el mismo GLOBAL SPEC** en las tres tandas para mantener la misma voz y estilo visual sin fluctuaciones.
2. El modo lote y el Creador de escenas deben ejecutarse desde Google Flow en la versión web para ordenador.
3. Revisa el control de calidad escena por escena antes de editar. Si algún clip presenta errores, relánzalo con la plantilla individual de relanzamiento, sin repetir el lote completo.
